devastated.title: Devastated
devastated.line: A shock call, it sits down hard, then the head droops and shakes 'no' on three soft sobs.

sad.title: Sad
sad.line: Still standing, the head droops while a low coo slides down with it, then two slow silent shakes.

curious.title: Curious
curious.line: 'What? What?': the head comes forward and tilts right, then left, on two rising chirps.

mmh.title: Mmh?
mmh.line: 'What do you mean?': a small head tilt with a muffled, rising 'mmh?'.

yes.title: Yes
yes.line: One clear nod with a quack that falls three semitones.

yes_fast.title: Yes!
yes_fast.line: The same nod with a curt 'wak'.

no.title: No
no.line: One head shake with a two-note 'no-ah'.

defiant.title: Defiant
defiant.line: 'Says who?': beak up to the left, then to the right, a curt quack each time.

impatient.title: Impatient
impatient.line: 'Come on!': four quick shakes with a grumble each, then the beak flicks up on a huff.

angry.title: Angry
angry.line: A beak-up glare, then four head snaps on four hard barks.

mock.title: Mock
mock.line: 'Gnagnagna': beak up, the head rolling side to side on a staccato run.

laugh.title: Laugh
laugh.line: Beak up, head wagging: one long 'haaa', then short ha's dying out.

excited.title: Excited
excited.line: Six faster and faster head swings with a bob each, every quack higher than the last.

play_dead.title: Play dead
play_dead.line: An alarm call, it sits, goes limp and rolls onto its back, legs up, one last quack.
